title: Bolsista Doutor - Akiyama - Impactos da Computação Quântica na Identificação e biometria | Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - IEL/PR
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses , promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado , ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico , favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico . A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências , e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável .

Sobre a Oportunidade:

Akiyama é referência nacional no desenvolvimento de tecnologias de identificação e segurança, com soluções inovadoras que atendem a setores como segurança pública, bancos, empresas privadas e órgãos governamentais. Nosso foco é criar produtos de alto desempenho em biometria, inteligência artificial e segurança da informação, sempre impulsionando a inovação e a transformação digital.

Estamos buscando um(a) profissional altamente qualificado(a) para integrar nosso time de P&D, contribuindo no desenvolvimento de soluções que combinam computação quântica, IA e cibersegurança aplicadas à biometria.

Formação Acadêmica:

Doutorado completo nas áreas de Ciência da Computação, Engenharia Elétrica, Física Aplicada, ou áreas correlatas.

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.

Projeto: Impactos da Computação Quântica na Identificação e biometria

Principais Atividades:

  • Propor arquiteturas híbridas (clássica + quântica) para otimização de tempo de processamento em sistemas biométricos;
  • Simular hardware quântico ou utilizar computadores quânticos reais em nuvem (IBM Quantum, D-Wave, Rigetti, entre outros);
  • Aplicar criptografia, física computacional, inteligência artificial e cibersegurança aos produtos da empresa.

Conhecimento necessário:

  • Criptografia quântica e algoritmos pós-quânticos (ex.: Lattice-based cryptography);
  • Computação quântica: modelos de computação (gate-based, annealing), uso de Qiskit ou similares, circuitos quânticos e simulação de algoritmos;
  • Machine Learning e Deep Learning aplicados à biometria;
  • Experiência com bibliotecas de IA (TensorFlow, PyTorch) e frameworks quânticos (Qiskit, Cirq, PennyLane).
  • Inglês Avançado.

Conhecimento desejável:

  • Processamento de sinais biométricos (impressões digitais, face, íris, palma da mão, voz, etc.);
  • Conhecimento em teorias de informação e codificação para proteção de templates biométricos (ex.: cancelable biometrics, fuzzy extractors).

Valor da bolsa (mensal) : Bolsista (Doutor) R$ 5.000 – Programa Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial

Formato de trabalho : Híbrido

Local: Curitiba/PR

Soft Skills : Trabalho em equipe; Autonomia; Organização.

title: Consultor de SAP sênior
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Nosso Cliente

Você atuará em parceria com um cliente de grande porte, em projetos estratégicos e relevantes, com foco em transformação digital e modernização de processos financeiros em ambiente SAP S/4HANA . O projeto terá início previsto para 19/01/2026 , com tempo de contrato de 6 meses e possibilidade de extensão, atuando em iniciativas voltadas a incorporação societária (M&A).

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar como Consultor(a) SAP FI Sênior em ambiente SAP S/4HANA
  • Participar de projetos de incorporação societária (M&A)
  • Configurar, acompanhar e dar suporte aos processos financeiros no SAP FI
  • Interface com áreas de negócio e times técnicos
  • Garantir aderência às melhores práticas SAP e qualidade das entregas

O que você precisa ter

  • Formação acadêmica obrigatória
  • Experiência sólida e comprovada em SAP FI
  • Conhecimento consolidado em SAP S/4HANA
  • Atuação prévia em projetos SAP FI

Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Vivência em projetos de incorporação societária (M&A)
  • Boa comunicação e facilidade de interação com stakeholders
  • Organização, autonomia e gestão do tempo
  • Perfil colaborativo, proativo e resiliente

Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Medical Director
description:
About our company:

Werfen: Global Leader in In Vitro Diagnostics

Founded in 1966, Werfen is one of t he world's leading companies in the development, manufacturing, and distribution of specialized diagnostic instruments, reagents, process automation solutions, and data management systems that empower patient care in hospitals and laboratories worldwide.

Our solutions in Hemostasis, Acute Care Diagnostics, Autoimmunity, Transplantation, and Transfusion are available in over 100 countries and territories through our direct operations and distributors. We are a team of more than 7,000 employees with an annual revenue exceeding $2 billion , reflecting our global presence in the industry.

In Brazil, we ar e leaders in diagnostic solutions for Hemostasis and Blood Gas Analysis . We have an office in Barueri (Alphaville), São Paulo , and a distribution center in Itajaí, Santa Catarina , providing our customers across the country with excellence and efficiency.

Position Summary:

The main role is to lead and execute the Medical strategy in the home country, as well as support initiatives for Latin America in a collaborative manner. The position aims to generate business demand by increasing the visibility of products and solutions through a clinical/scientific approach, influencing physicians, professional societies, and healthcare institutions, and promoting the adoption of these solutions as the standard of care, in order to achieve sales objectives.

Key Responsabilities:

  • Develop and lead the medical strategy, ensuring clinical excellence and regulatory compliance.
  • Collaborate with executive leaders to align medical objectives with the company's vision and mission.
  • Oversee the implementation of effective clinical practices and ensure adherence to regulatory standards.
  • Participate in strategic decision-making related to the development of new products and portfolio expansion.
  • Create, validate, and effectively communicate scientific information related to the company's products. This involves translating complex scientific data into clear and persuasive messages that support the perception and acceptance of our medical products in the market.
  • Establish and maintain strategic relationships with societies, opinion leaders, physicians, laboratory professionals, and other healthcare specialists. The goal is to understand their needs, share relevant product information, and gather valuable feedback that contributes to continuous improvement.
  • Design educational and promotional plans for the scientific community.
  • Plan and execute programs and activities aimed at improving the skills, knowledge, and competencies of teams interacting with clients, such as sales, marketing, and others.
  • Provide leadership and guidance to medical professionals and clinical staff in the context of diagnostic and medical devices.
  • Participate in resolving issues related to the company's products and services.
  • Stay updated on medical advancements, regulations, and trends specific to the diagnostic and medical device industry.

Skills and Competences

  • Deep Knowledge in Medicine and Health Sciences: Expertise in relevant therapeutic areas, clinical protocols, and regulatory guidelines.
  • Planning and Execution of Clinical Trials: Ability to design, manage, and evaluate clinical trials effectively.
  • Understanding of GCP and Regulatory Guidelines: Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and local and international regulatory standards.
  • Scientific Publications and Data Communication: Experience in writing and reviewing scientific publications and in communicating research data clearly and persuasively.

Minimum Knowledge and Experience Required for the Role (education, experience, and training):

1.Education:

  • Professional with training in Healthcare areas (Medicine, Pharmacist, Chemistry, Biology, genetics or any other health sciences).

2.Experience:

  • More than 5 years of experience in the healthcare industry (pharmaceutical industry or medical device) or in medical affairs.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of Good Clinical Practice (GCP) guidelines and applicable clinical practice guidelines, as well as the healthcare ecosystem in which the role will operate.

title: Technical Support Engineer (Tier 2)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Technical Support Engineer with 2+ years of software support experience to join our U.S. client's customer support team. In this role, you will provide daily technical support, assisting customers in resolving their software and compliance-related issues. You will work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Product teams, and you will have access to tool subscriptions, such as Enterprise ChatGPT, Grammarly, and GitHub Copilot (if required), to deliver exceptional support.

Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform enables companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure their efficacy against compliance standards, and share achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.

Responsibilities

  • Drive resolution of customer issues, act as a customer advocate, and maintain happy and satisfied customers
  • Follow the client's customer support process and meet established service level agreements (SLAs)
  • Triage support requests by conducting a first-level investigation of technical product issues
  • Provide continuous and timely updates on issue resolution status to customers and key internal stakeholders
  • Engage with the Engineering team to ensure timely resolution of customer issues according to SLAs and escalate when necessary to meet those goals

Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • University degree with a major in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 2+ years of customer support experience for a commercial software product
  • Passion for providing technical support to customers and helping them gain success using client products
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate and troubleshoot product issues by reproducing the problem, examining application logs, and reviewing debug messages and stack traces
  • Strong problem-solving capabilities in a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) application environment
  • First point of customer contact and an ability to act independently, as well as a willingness to involve a manager and others when in need of assistance
  • A quick learner who is inquisitive about new products and features
  • Career-minded and willing to take on the responsibilities of learning new software development languages and tools while still maintaining an exceptionally high standard of support delivery
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent

Preferred Experience

  • Demonstrated capabilities using the Chrome Browser Development Toolset when appropriate to solve specific problems
  • Experience with Atlassian/Jira
  • Experience with Linux commands and networking will be a significant advantage
  • Other skills that will help the candidate stand out are as follows:
  • REST APIs (in Postman)
  • JavaScript basics (any programming language)
  • Basic SQL commands
  • Log aggregation and monitoring tools, such as DataDog
  • Experience using project management tools, such as Jira

Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

Core Client Values

The client's values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.

  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders, proving we are dependable
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk
  • Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger

The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people on board from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.

About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Senior Back-End Engineer (PHP, Node.js, OR Python)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Back-End Engineer with 5+ years of experience. The role focuses on designing and building the secure, scalable API and service integrations that connect SaaS products, data warehouse, and embedded analytics ecosystem.

This role acts as the bridge between the application stack and the data platform, ensuring that analytics, reporting, and automation capabilities are seamlessly exposed to both internal systems and customer-facing applications.

The ideal candidate is a backend engineer experienced with modern frameworks (PHP, Node.js, or Python), API design, multi-tenant authentication (Auth0/SSO), and data service abstractions. They combine strong engineering fundamentals with a deep appreciation for performance, security, and maintainability.

Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System integrating booking, guest communications, and financial reporting systems - all built with partner organization integrations in mind.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement RESTful and GraphQL APIs that expose warehouse and reporting data to SaaS applications and third-party systems
  • Develop scalable, tenant-aware service layers that abstract complex Redshift or Snowflake queries behind stable, versioned interfaces

  • Ensure multi-tenant context propagation and data isolation across all API endpoints
  • Work with the Data Platform and Analytics teams to define reusable data-access abstractions
  • Collaborate with the Data Platform Architect to design backend patterns supporting large-scale, automated reporting workloads
  • Implement caching, pagination, and batching strategies for high-volume, concurrent
  • analytics requests
  • Monitor API latency and database query efficiency, applying indexing and optimization
  • where necessary
  • Contribute to system design documentation, endpoint versioning, and architecture diagrams
  • Integrate SSO and identity management (Auth0, Cognito, or OIDC) into all service endpoints
  • Enforce least-privilege data access and row-level security (RLS) through token or role propagation
  • Ensure compliance with PII and data governance policies, encryption standards, and audit logging
  • Collaborate with InfoSec and Compliance teams to perform code reviews and security assessments
  • Work with DevOps to deploy and scale backend services via Docker, ECS, or EKS pipelines
  • Implement CI/CD automation for service deployment, schema migrations, and integration tests
  • Contribute to infrastructure-as-code definitions (Terraform or CloudFormation)
  • Support observability and monitoring via CloudWatch, Datadog, or OpenTelemetry
  • Partner with Analytics Engineers and Data Platform teams to ensure APIs align with data contracts and warehouse schemas
  • Collaborate with Product Managers to define API requirements and roadmap priorities
  • Participate in technical design reviews, security audits, and postmortems
  • Continuously improve service performance, reliability, and developer experience

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of backend or integration engineering experience in a modern web stack
  • Proficiency in PHP (Laminas, Symfony, Laravel), Node.js, or Python for backend service development
  • Experience designing and maintaining RESTful and GraphQL APIs at scale
  • Hands-on experience integrating data warehouse APIs (Redshift, Snowflake) or analytics services (QuickSight, Tableau, Power BI)
  • Solid understanding of multi-tenant authentication and authorization (SSO, OAuth2, OpenID Connect)
  • Familiarity with AWS services including Lambda, API Gateway, ECS/EKS, and CloudFormation
  • Strong knowledge of SQL and data-access patterns, including query optimization and caching
  • Proven experience implementing CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and API observability

Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or some type of technical engineering
  • Experience with embedded analytics frameworks (AWS QuickSight Embedding SDK, Looker Embed, etc.)
  • Familiarity with multi-tenant SaaS architectures (tenant isolation, provisioning, and lifecycle automation)
  • Knowledge of GraphQL federation, caching layers (Redis), and event-driven designs
  • Experience in data-driven SaaS products (hospitality, property management, or fintech a plus)
  • Exposure to data governance, lineage, and API auditing practices

Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Salesforce Apex Developer
description:
Salesforce Apex Developer

Location : Brazil

We are looking a seasoned Salesforce engineer, who designs, develops, and optimizes secure, scalable solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, and SOQL/SOSL.

Responsibilities

· Design, develop, and unit-test Apex classes, triggers, batch jobs, queueables, schedulables, and platform events in multi-org environments.

· Build modern UIs with LWC/Aura, integrating with server-side Apex and Salesforce Data APIs.

· Implement secure, compliant solutions (field-level security, sharing model, FLS/CRUD checks, with platform encryption where applicable).

· Own integration patterns (REST/SOAP, callouts, Platform Events, Change Data Capture) and middleware (e.g., MuleSoft/Boomi/Informatica) as needed.

· Optimize performance (selective queries, bulkification, governor limits, transaction control) and improve org health via code reviews and static analysis.

· Define CI/CD pipelines (Copado/AutoRABIT/GitHub Actions), branching strategies, and automated testing (Apex tests, Jest for LWC).

· Collaborate in Scrum/Agile ceremonies, estimate work, and deliver increments; provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior developers.

· Document solution designs, sequence/data models, and deployment runbooks; support UAT and production releases with high reliability.

Requirements

· Experience in Salesforce development; strong Apex expertise designing enterprise-grade solutions.

· Hands-on with LWC, Aura, Visualforce, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Data Service, and Salesforce Security/sharing model.

· Experience with integration (REST/SOAP/Webhooks), middleware and eventing

· Proficiency with DevOps/CI-CD on Salesforce (Copado/AutoRABIT/Git), test automation, code quality tools (PMD, ESLint for LWC).

· Solid understanding of governor limits, bulk patterns, transaction control, and performance tuning at scale.

· Experience working in agile teams; strong communication skills in English (C1) to work with global stakeholders.

· Preferred: Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer I/II, JavaScript Developer I), experience with Heroku, SSO/Security, and Unit/E2E testing frameworks

title: Assistente de Qualidade
description:
A ZeBrands é uma família de marcas presentes em diferentes segmentos – descanso, casa, viagens, entre outros – que nasceu como uma startup no México em 2015 com o compromisso de oferecer produtos de alta qualidade e uma experiência excepcional aos clientes.

A Luuna foi a primeira dessas marcas, introduzindo o conceito de colchões em caixa na América Latina e tornando-se uma referência no mercado mexicano. Com mais de 2 milhões de clientes e ultrapassando 200 lojas próprias, foi a linha escolhida para liderar a expansão da Zebrands ao Brasil.

A chegada por aqui aconteceu no início de 2022 e, desde então, estamos nos consolidando, conquistando uma grande quantidade de clientes e atingindo taxas aceleradas de crescimento mês após mês. O Brasil está no centro dos planos estratégicos da ZeBrands e estamos prontos para alçar voos ainda mais altos.

Se você procura um ambiente desafiador e dinâmico, dentro de uma empresa em ascensão, com amplas oportunidades de crescimento, venha fazer parte da nossa equipe!

Saiba mais em luuna.com.br e zebrands.

Sobre a posição

Você tem a missão de se desenvolver pessoalmente e profissionalmente ao participar da expansão da Zebrands no Brasil. Estimulamos a autonomia em ambiente colaborativo com contato diário com diferentes áreas e lideranças, tanto do Brasil quanto do México.

Buscamos pessoas que estejam dispostas a explorar o universo do varejo com a gente. Acreditamos que pessoas com diferentes histórias, formações, experiências e habilidades nos ajudarão a construir a Zebrands no Brasil.

Na posição, você será responsável por criar processos do zero e ser um dos defensores da qualidade dos nossos produtos (colchões e travesseiros). Seu papel é essencial para estruturação da área aqui na empresa.

Principais atividades

  • Realizar inspeções de recebimento de produtos, avaliando conformidade com especificações técnicas e padrões de qualidade;
  • Executar inspeções em produtos devolvidos, analisando causas de não conformidade e registrando evidências;
  • Conduzir inspeções de expedição, assegurando que os produtos estejam em conformidade antes do envio ao cliente;
  • Registrar resultados de inspeção em formulários, planilhas ou sistemas internos;
  • Sinalizar não conformidades e colaborar com as áreas envolvidas (Logística, Produção, SAC) para tratativas;
  • Apoiar na manutenção de registros da qualidade.

Requisitos e Expectativas

  • Formação concluída ou em andamento em: Qualidade ou Logística (nível técnico);
  • Experiência mínima de 2 anos na área de qualidade;
  • Experiência com sistemas WMS (gestão de estoque – produtos não conformes);
  • Conhecimento/Experiência na ISO 9001:2015 (desejável).

Remuneração e Benefícios

  • Salário compatível com o mercado;
  • Plano de Saúde SulAmérica (Sem desconto na folha);
  • Plano Odontológico SulAmérica (Sem desconto na folha);
  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação (Sem desconto na folha);
  • Vale Transporte (Sem desconto na folha);
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Total Pass;
  • Day Off aniversário;
  • Desconto em produtos da marca;
  • Conversas construtivas com os gestores;
  • Ambiente desafiador, de desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional.

title: Sales Development Representative - Brazil
description:
Sales Development Representative (Outbound)

São Paulo, Brazil | SDR Team | Full-time

Are you creative to adapt to the changing landscape of modern selling?

Is connecting and generating lead in different markets excites you?

Do you have the grit to keep going and still be creative?

If so, come build your future as part of our Sales Development team servicing clients in diverse geographies.

The Impact you will create in the Job:

  • You will manage the entire sales process, starting from generating interest to first customer contact to setting up qualified meetings for the Sales team.
  • You will build a strong pipeline of Sales Qualified Opportunities by penetrating new accounts.
  • Actively analyze and identify the roadblocks in our customer engagement and retention
  • Follow up on leads and conduct research to identify potential prospects and build relations by initiating communications and doing follow-ups in order to move opportunities through the sales funnel.
  • You will deploy a mix of high-volume cold calling (a minimum of 60+ dials per day), emailing & social selling techniques in order to access decision makers.
  • You will manage all prospective clients and opportunities in CRM, ensuring all communications are accurately logged.
  • You will redefine outbound strategies and improve conversion rates across the SDR pipeline.
  • Working with cross functional teams to develop and grow the sales pipeline and consistently meet the revenue targets, thereby maintaining healthy metrics and KPIs.
  • Taking extreme ownership of your work and coordinating closely with the marketing team to ensure alignment of common goals.

What we look for?

  • At least 2 years of experience in phone-based, outbound B2B sales development / inside sales role.
  • Excellent proficiency in English communication, both written & verbal.
  • Clear, compelling, and personalized communication across email and social media platforms to suit the shifting needs of our prospects.
  • Positive speaking skills, strong listening skills, writing skills
  • Have the grit to handle rejections efficiently.
  • Good understanding of running and executing email drip campaigns.
  • Proven ability to undertake in-depth online research, and via social media.
  • Ability to work and easily adapt to an ever-changing fast-paced environment.
  • Most importantly, you should have long-term plans to pursue a career in Sales or Sales Development.

Why Netcore?

Being first is in our nature. The first and leading AI/ML-powered marketing automation enabling better customer engagements for businesses of all sizes with cutting-edge technologies that include AI, automation, top-notch product experience, customer data platform, communication API, and multi-channel client engagement options, - a comprehensive customer experience platform to enhance and exhilarate the client journey.

Netcore has a perfect combo of experience as well as an agile mind. We are currently serving more than 70% of B2C Unicorns in India and 5000+ brands across 18 countries, making us among the top-rated marketing automation suite for enterprises.

Headquartered in Mumbai, we have our global footprints across 10 countries worldwide. Being certified as a Great Place to Work for three consecutive years only reinforces Netcore’s principle of being a people-centric company – where you will not be just an employee but a family member of the organization.

A career at Netcore is more than just a job — it’s an opportunity to shape the future. For more information, please visit netcorecloud.com or follow us on LinkedIn.

What’s in it for you?

  • Immense growth, continuous learning and connect with the top-notch brands
  • Work with some of the most innovative brains
  • Opportunity to explore the Brazil market with your entrepreneurial mindset
  • Open culture where your creative bug gets activated
  • Opportunity to pitch multiple products

If this sounds like a company you would like to be a part of, and a role you would thrive in, please don’t hold back from applying! We need your unique perspective for our continued innovation and success!

So let’s converse! Our inquisitive nature is all keen to know more about you.

title: Electrical Engineer
description:
We Are Hiring: Electrical Engineer (São Paulo, Brazil)

The Electrical Engineer will play a key role in the design, coordination, and delivery of electrical systems for mission-critical infrastructure projects. This position supports multidisciplinary teams throughout the full project lifecycle—from conceptual and detailed design to construction support and commissioning—ensuring technical excellence, compliance with Brazilian electrical regulations, and constructability. This role is based in São Paulo, Brazil .

Main Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Develop electrical infrastructure designs, including medium- and low-voltage systems, grounding, lighting, and auxiliary electrical systems.
  • Prepare preliminary studies, technical designs, and engineering documentation for electrical systems in compliance with Brazilian standards and best practices.
  • Develop electrical calculation memoranda, including load studies, short-circuit analysis, protection coordination, and lighting calculations.
  • Perform technical supervision, inspections, and/or commissioning activities as required.
  • Develop construction drawings and installation plans for electrical and low-voltage systems.
  • Generate technical reports and formal engineering deliverables.
  • Work cross-functionally with internal teams, clients, and external stakeholders.
  • Act as Project Engineer on assignments involving electrical design scope and multidisciplinary coordination.
  • Support monitoring of project progress, engineering deliverables, and schedules to ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electromechanical Engineering, or equivalent.
  • Active Brazilian professional license (CREA), in good standing, with legal authority to sign and stamp engineering documents (ART).
  • Strong ability to read, interpret, and review electrical designs and schematics.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD and/or BIM tools (Revit or similar).
  • Willingness and ability to develop and apply electrical engineering tools such as ETAP and Dialux .
  • Knowledge of the National Electrical Code (NEC) ; familiarity with Brazilian standards (ABNT / NBR) is a plus.
  • English level B1, with the ability to participate fluently in technical meetings, calls, and professional discussions.
  • Previous experience in Data Center or other mission-critical facilities is highly desirable.

If you are motivated by technically complex electrical systems, regulatory-intensive environments, and critical infrastructure projects, we would love to hear from you. Join a team delivering high-impact data center projects across the region.

title: Global Quality Manager
description:
Location: Caxias do Sul, Brazil

Industry: Automotive Manufacturing

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Global Quality Manager to lead and enhance our quality management systems across international operations. The ideal candidate will have a strong track record in the automotive industry , especially with OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers. This role demands strategic thinking, excellent leadership, and hands-on expertise in driving continuous improvement and product excellence.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the development and implementation of the global quality management system in compliance with IATF 16949, VDA 6.3 and ISO 9001 standards.
  • Ensure consistent quality performance across global sites and alignment with customer expectations.
  • Oversee customer quality relations with OEMs, ensuring quick resolution of issues and proactive improvement.
  • Promote continuous improvement through tools like APQP, FMEA, PPAP, 8D , and Six Sigma .
  • Define and monitor key quality KPIs and develop action plans to enhance performance.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality Management, or a related field ( Master’s degree preferred ).
  • Proven experience in the automotive industry —preferably with OEMs or Tier 1 suppliers.
  • Deep understanding of automotive quality systems and methodologies (IATF 16949, ISO 9001, APQP, FMEA, PPAP, etc.).
  • Fluent English (additional languages are a plus).
  • Strong analytical, leadership, and communication skills.
  • Willingness to travel internationally when required.

Why Join Us

Join a global, forward-thinking team dedicated to innovation, quality, and sustainability in the automotive industry. You will have the opportunity to shape and elevate our global quality strategy while contributing to high-impact projects worldwide.

description:
Key Responsibilities

  • Bachelor's degree or above in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related fields. Professional certifications such as CPA, CMA are preferred.

title: Ad Operations Specialist
description:
Ad Operations Agent

About the Role

We’re looking for an Ad Operations Agent with strong exposure to the programmatic advertising ecosystem , especially on the publisher side . The ideal candidate has hands-on experience running ad campaigns end-to-end—understanding how ads are set up, validated, trafficked, and go live , with a proven ability to optimize performance across publisher platforms. Familiarity with DSPs, SSPs, and ad tech tools is essential, though deep expertise in every platform is not required.

Work model: 100% training from office in single shift and post that Hybrid in 24*7 shift model

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage & execute programmatic campaigns across publisher platforms from setup to launch.
  • Coordinate ad trafficking, QA, and go-live across multiple inventory sources (web, app, CTV as applicable).
  • Monitor & optimize delivery and pacing for performance KPIs: impressions, fill rate, viewability, CPM/eCPM, CTR, revenue , etc.
  • Troubleshoot ad delivery issues involving creatives, tags, wrappers, targeting, brand safety, and reporting discrepancies.
  • Collaborate with sales, product, yield, and engineering to ensure smooth execution and timely issue resolution.
  • Analyze performance data to provide actionable insights that improve monetization and yield.
  • Ensure compliance with publisher policies, brand safety , ad quality standards, and privacy regulations.
  • Support integrations & workflows involving SSPs, ad servers, and DSPs (e.g., line items, deals, private marketplaces, header bidding).
  • Maintain documentation & reporting for live and completed campaigns, including post-campaign analysis.
  • Contribute to process improvement , playbooks, and best practices for ad ops and yield optimization.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Strong understanding of the ad tech ecosystem and programmatic workflows (publisher-side).
  • Hands-on experience with publisher-side tools: ad servers (e.g., Google Ad Manager), SSPs, yield management .
  • Knowledge of how ads are processed end-to-end: ingestion, validation, approvals, trafficking, optimization, delivery.
  • Familiarity with DSPs (e.g., DV360, The Trade Desk, MediaMath , or similar) and how they transact with publisher inventory.
  • Experience with ad servers and trafficking concepts: line items, creatives, tags, macros, targeting, frequency caps, passbacks, priority levels.
  • Solid understanding of ad formats (display, video, native, rich media) and associated measurement (viewability, VAST/VPAID, MRC standards).
  • Ability to analyze campaign data and optimize for eCPM, fill rate, viewability, revenue, and delivery .
  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills with attention to detail.
  • Clear communication and cross-functional coordination skills; comfortable working with technical and commercial teams.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with header bidding (Prebid, TAM, Open Bidding) and deal management (PMPs, programmatic guaranteed).
  • Comfort with privacy & compliance topics (GDPR, CCPA, COPPA) and brand safety solutions (IAS, DoubleVerify, MOAT).
  • Familiarity with reporting and analytics tools (Looker, Tableau, Google Analytics, GAM queries).
  • Basic understanding of ad quality , creative validation , blocklists/allowlists , and supply path optimization .
  • Experience with CTV/mobile app monetization , SDKs, and mediation (if relevant to your stack).
  • SQL or Excel proficiency for data analysis is a plus.

Tools & Platforms (Examples)

  • Ad Server: Google Ad Manager (GAM) or equivalent
  • SSPs: Magnite, PubMatic, Xandr, Index Exchange, OpenX (as applicable)
  • DSPs: DV360, The Trade Desk, MediaMath, Amazon DSP (familiarity required, deep expertise not mandatory)
  • Verification/Brand Safety: IAS, DoubleVerify, MOAT
  • Tagging/QA: VAST/VPAID validation, creative wrappers, custom macros
  • Analytics/Reporting: GAM reporting, Excel/Sheets, BI tools

description:
Função: Técnico Telecomunicações e Redes

Escala de Trabalho: 12x35 Noturno - 18hs às 6hs

Trabalho 100% presencial, sem possibilidade de regime híbrido ou remoto.

Formação:

Técnico(a) em Telecomunicações ou Técnico(a) em Redes de Computadores ou superior em áreas correlacionadas

Resumo do Cargo:

O Técnico(a) em Telecomunicações ou Técnico(a) em Redes de Computadores é responsável por manter sistemas de telecomunicações e infraestrutura de rede, assegurando a disponibilidade, confiabilidade e segurança dos serviços de comunicação de dados e voz. Atua diretamente na configuração de equipamentos de rede, rádios, modems celulares, terminais satelitais e servidores de comunicação, garantindo conectividade local e remota.

Esse profissional desempenha papel essencial no suporte e manutenção da infraestrutura de redes corporativas, realizando diagnósticos, testes de desempenho, ajustes de configuração e registrando incidentes para garantir a continuidade operacional.

Requisitos obrigatórios:

Conhecimento básico em utilização de plataformas de monitoração (ex: Zabbix).

Conhecimento básico em utilização de plataformas de gestão de chamados (ex: OTRS, ServiceNow, etc.).

Conhecimento básico em utilização de plataformas de visualização de dados (ex: Grafana, Power BI, etc.).

Conhecimento nas melhores práticas em Cibersegurança e Segurança da Informação.

Nível básico em pacote Office (Word, Excel, Power Point).

Habilidades interpessoais:

Comunicação eficaz (capacidade de comunicar problemas técnicos de forma clara e concisa, tanto para equipes de campo quanto para liderança);

Resolução de problemas (capacidade para diagnosticar e resolver problemas rapidamente);

Trabalho em equipe (colaboração com outros membros da equipe e departamentos);

Gestão do tempo (priorização, gerenciamento de múltiplos tickets simultaneamente, organização e atenção a detalhes).

Requisitos desejáveis:

Experiência anterior na área de TI e/ou central de monitoração e incidentes/problemas.

Conhecimento em sistemas elétricos, automação, proteção e medição.

Inglês ou Espanhol - Nível básico

Conhecimentos técnicos desejados:

- Sistemas de Telecomunicações: princípios básicos de transmissão de dados e voz, multiplexação, enlaces de rádio, satélite e celular.

- Configuração de rádios: ajuste de frequências, largura de banda, potência, polarização e alinhamento de antenas.

- Protocolos de rede: TCP/IP, UDP, SNMP, ICMP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, QoS.

- Modelo OSI: entendimento das camadas físicas, de enlace, rede, transporte e aplicação, aplicando conceitos em troubleshooting.

- Configuração de equipamentos de rede:

o Switches: criação e gerenciamento de VLANs, configuração de STP, portas trunk e access.

o Roteadores: configuração de rotas estáticas, protocolos de roteamento dinâmico (OSPF, BGP básico).

o Terminal Server: configuração de acesso remoto seguro e tunelamento.

- Modems celulares e satelitais: configuração de APNs, endereçamento IP, failover e redundância de links.

- Segurança de rede: noções de firewall, ACLs e VPNs.

title: DevOps Pleno - GCP
description:

O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um/uma DevOps para fazer parte de nosso movimento. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por gerenciar o ciclo de vida completo de aplicações, desde o desenvolvimento até a entrega em produção, garantindo eficiência e agilidade por meio da automação e de metodologias ágeis.

  • Gerenciar e manter ambientes em cloud (GCP) , garantindo escalabilidade, segurança e eficiência.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de infraestrutura como código (IaC) utilizando Terraform .

  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos e da arquitetura de infraestrutura.

Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:

  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Kubernetes , com experiência na administração de clusters, deploys (Helm/Manifests), configuração de RBAC, network policies e troubleshooting em produção.
  • Experiência com GitOps utilizando Argo CD , incluindo implementação e manutenção de pipelines, gestão de sincronização de aplicações e rollback automatizado.
  • Experiência com GitLab , aplicando CI/CD para pipelines complexos, runners, templates e integração com ambientes cloud.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em GCP , com vivência prática em serviços como Compute Engine, Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage, IAM, VPC, autoscaling e otimização de custos.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Terraform , incluindo desenvolvimento e manutenção de módulos reutilizáveis, gerenciamento de estado remoto e versionamento de infraestrutura.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace, configurando métricas, alertas, dashboards e tracing.
  • Experiência com scripting e automação , utilizando Python, Bash ou Go para automação de operações, criação de pipelines e integrações.
  • Vivência prática com CI/CD , desenhando, implementando e otimizando pipelines de integração e entrega contínua, com testes automatizados e estratégias de rollout (canary, blue/green).
  • Conhecimento em práticas de segurança em cloud e containers , incluindo hardening de clusters, gestão de segredos, políticas de acesso e scanners de vulnerabilidade.

title: Senior Full Stack AI Engineer
description:
About Us

Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology.

Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation.

The Mission

We are looking for a Senior Engineer to replace a key member of our technical team. You will be joining a group working on a revolutionary product designed to completely transform the United States Insurance Industry. This is not just a standard CRUD application; we are building complex workflows involving AI agents and browser-based tooling to modernize a legacy industry.

The Role

You will act as a Full Stack Developer with a heavy emphasis on Backend and AI logic. While Python is your primary weapon for new development, you must be versatile enough to tune existing Node.js services and handle frontend requirements in Angular and Chrome Extensions.

We are looking for someone who understands Agentic Workflows —how to organize AI models to perform complex tasks—not just someone who knows how to make a simple API call to OpenAI.

Key Responsibilities

  • AI & Backend Architecture: Design and implement robust backend services using Python. You will lead the development of AI Agents, defining how they interact, manage context, and execute tasks.
  • Browser-Based Innovation : Maintain and expand our core Chrome Extension product. This is a critical interface for our users.
  • Service Tuning: Interface with and optimize existing microservices written in Node.js . You don’t need to be a Node expert, but you must be comfortable reading, debugging, and tuning this code.
  • Frontend Maintenance: implement UI/UX features using Angular . While the role is backend-heavy, you should be comfortable jumping into the frontend to ship complete features.
  • Light Infrastructure: Handle very basic deployment or configuration tasks (DevOps is not a primary duty, but “infrastructure awareness” is required).

What we’re looking for

  • Seniority: 5+ years of commercial software development experience.
  • Python Mastery: Deep experience with Python for backend development.
  • AI/Agent Experience: proven experience working with LLMs and AI Agents. You understand the architecture of agentic frameworks (loops, memory, tools).
  • Note: Specific framework knowledge (LangChain, CrewAI) is a plus, but a strong conceptual grasp of how agents are organized is mandatory.
  • Node.js Proficiency: Ability to read, understand, and patch Node.js environments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with LangChain or CrewAI .
  • Experience building or maintaining complex browser extensions (manifest v3, background scripts, content injection).
  • Previous experience in the InsurTech or Fintech sectors.
  • Background in modernizing legacy workflows with automation.
  • Familiarity with Angular .

Why Join Us?

  • Impact: Work on a product that is actively changing how the US insurance market operates.
  • Cutting Edge Tech: We are not just talking about AI; we are implementing agentic workflows in production.
  • Remote Culture: Work from anywhere with a team that values output over hours.

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

Job Title: On-Site Technical Support Engineer

Location: Brasília, Brazil

We are seeking a skilled and responsive Technical Support Engineer to provide critical on-site support to our clinet Tiktok in Brasilia. ( As our recruitment team does not speak the local language, we can only accept

title: Senior Graphic Designer (Figma, Marketing & Paid Social)
description:
We’re hiring a Senior Graphic Designer who works daily in Figma and designs high-converting landing pages, emails, and paid social ads for e-commerce brands.

Job Title: Senior Graphic Designer (Figma, Landing Pages, Email & Performance Ads)

Company: Sender Agency

Location: Remote (LATAM preferred, East Coast or Central Time overlap)

Type: Full-Time, Monday to Friday

Compensation: $1,600 to $2,500 USD per month

We’re hiring a Senior Graphic Designer who works daily in Figma and designs high-converting landing pages, emails, and paid social ads for e-commerce brands.

This role is performance-focused. You will design assets that drive clicks, conversions, and revenue across the funnel.

If you have strong taste and understand how design impacts CRO, this role is for you.

About Sender Agency

Sender Agency is a performance-focused creative agency that has spent the last seven years building and scaling e-commerce brands. We have worked with blue-chip and celebrity-backed companies including Cacti by Travis Scott, Just Water by Will Smith, Alice Mushrooms, and brands backed by Patrick Mahomes.

Our team has launched brands from zero and helped scale existing businesses past $20M in revenue. Design plays a central role in that growth. We care about how things look, but more importantly, we care about how they perform.

The Role

We are hiring a Senior Graphic Designer to own landing page design, email design, and paid advertising creative using Figma.

This is a hands-on role for a designer who understands that strong visuals support conversion and that landing pages, emails, and ads must work together as a system.

You will work closely with the founders, media buyers, and copywriters to produce creative that is visually strong, conversion-focused, and built to scale.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Designing conversion-focused landing pages in Figma for e-commerce brands
  • Creating email designs for Klaviyo, including flows and campaigns
  • Producing high-volume paid social ad creative for Meta and other platforms
  • Maintaining visual consistency across ads, emails, and landing pages
  • Iterating quickly using templates, systems, and AI-assisted workflows
  • Using AI tools for image generation and rapid creative iteration
  • Collaborating with founders, media buyers, and copywriters
  • Improving creative based on performance feedback such as CTR, thumb-stop rate, and conversion rate

Who You Are

  • A senior-level graphic designer with strong taste and performance instincts
  • Highly proficient in Figma, especially for landing pages and email systems
  • Experienced with conversion-focused design and CRO principles
  • Comfortable producing a high volume of work without sacrificing quality
  • Organized, proactive, and able to manage your own workload
  • Clear and professional in written and spoken English

Bonus experience: familiarity with AI-driven creative workflows, basic copywriting instincts, and understanding of Meta ad performance metrics

Why You’ll Like Working Here

Sender Agency operates with a flat team structure. Strong ideas are encouraged regardless of role or title. You will work directly with the founders and be trusted to take ownership of your work.

We value people who take initiative, solve problems independently, and follow through. This is a results-driven environment with a strong creative culture and high standards.

About the Founders

Richard – Worked on the global marketing team at Levi’s and led creative and content at Chubbies. Background in brand and storytelling at a high level.

Alan – Career in VC-backed media and tech companies. Has helped build, scale, and exit multiple businesses.

Together, they bring a balance of brand thinking and performance execution.

Role Details

  • Full-time, Monday through Friday
  • Working hours aligned with East Coast or Central Time
  • Fully remote, with preference for candidates based in Latin America
  • Long-term role with real ownership

Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a paid test task to ensure alignment on quality, speed, and performance thinking.

Final Note

This role is demanding, but it offers real ownership and meaningful impact. You will not just be designing assets. You will be contributing directly to how brands grow and perform.

If you are a senior designer who cares about results and wants to work closely with a high-caliber team, we would like to hear from you.

— Richard Tubman

  • Sender Agency

title: Remote SAT English Tutor - 50997
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.

Role Overview:

Day-to-day responsibilities:

As an SAT Tutor, you will work remotely with high school students preparing for U.S. college admissions. Your sessions will focus on strengthening reading, writing, and mathematical reasoning skills using official materials and proven strategies. You’ll conduct timed practice tests, review performance, and create personalized study plans to help students maximize their scores. Clear communication, consistent feedback, and student motivation will be essential to building confidence and exam readiness.

Requirements:

We’re seeking experienced tutors with a strong record of preparing students for the SAT. Candidates should understand the digital SAT format, be familiar with College Board materials, and have excellent academic English skills. High SAT scores or standardized test prep certifications are preferred. Strong teaching abilities, virtual instruction skills, and a results-driven approach are essential. Communication in English: Ability to clearly convey feedback, nuances, and progress updates to the team.

Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.

Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: Availability of up to 40 hours per week is preferred
  • Engagement type: Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract: 1 month
  • This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los-Angeles

Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will go through an interview.
  • Once you clear the interview, you are ready to go!

After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals , and earn money from your network.

title: UX / UI Designer
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital. Somos globais, somos GPTW.

Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys! Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!

Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:

Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

Descritivo de Cargo: UX / UI Designer Especialista

Híbrido 1x semana Barueri

Inglês Avançado Desejável

Visão Geral do Papel

Profissional responsável por atuar como referência técnica em UX e UI, conduzindo pesquisas, definições de arquitetura, design de interfaces, testes e análises com alto grau de complexidade. Atua de forma estratégica, conectando experiência do usuário, métricas de negócio e viabilidade técnica, apoiando decisões de produto e evolução contínua das soluções digitais.

Pesquisa e Descoberta do Usuário

Conduz benchmarks estratégicos e multidimensionais, atuando como referência técnica para análises comparativas e direcionamento de mercado.

Define objetivos de pesquisa alinhados à estratégia de produto, garantindo clareza e foco para o time.

Seleciona, adapta e cria métodos de pesquisa para contextos complexos, assegurando rigor metodológico.

Conduz entrevistas de média e alta complexidade, orientando outros profissionais na escolha de abordagens.

Planeja e executa pesquisas, questionários e estudos de viabilidade, definindo critérios de validação.

Realiza análises aprofundadas de resultados, transformando dados em recomendações estratégicas.

Desenvolve mapas de jornada do usuário baseados em dados reais, identificando fricções e oportunidades.

Sintetiza e comunica insights de forma clara, estratégica e orientada a dados.

Desenha e orienta experimentos e hipóteses de validação, fortalecendo a cultura de testes.

Facilita dinâmicas de co-criação, consolidando aprendizados em materiais estratégicos.

Conduz análises heurísticas e orienta a priorização de melhorias com base em usabilidade.

Arquitetura da Informação e Fluxos (UX)

Constrói e evolui personas e cenários de uso conectados à estratégia do produto.

Desenvolve wireframes escaláveis, priorizando reutilização e eficiência.

Cria fluxos de usuário complexos, atuando como referência em caminhos críticos de navegação.

Estrutura a arquitetura da informação com foco em clareza, escalabilidade e eficiência.

Documenta decisões de UX e atua como referência na padronização e comunicação entre Design, Produto e Tecnologia.

Design de Interfaces (UI)

Analisa e otimiza navegação com base em dados de uso e métricas de negócio.

Aplica e orienta práticas avançadas de Design Centrado no Usuário (UCD).

Atua como referência visual, garantindo consistência com a identidade da marca.

Desenvolve soluções de design responsivo para múltiplos dispositivos.

Aplica boas práticas de tipografia, hierarquia visual, ícones e ilustrações.

Desenha microinterações e define padrões reutilizáveis.

Cria protótipos de alta fidelidade e orienta boas práticas de validação e documentação.

Testes de Usabilidade e Acessibilidade

Aplica normas de acessibilidade com profundidade técnica.

Desenvolve e evolui componentes e padrões de design system.

Explora interações avançadas, promovendo fluidez e consistência.

Planeja e executa testes de usabilidade, moderados e não moderados.

Define e valida hipóteses de teste, incluindo testes A/B e multivariados.

Analisa resultados com rigor técnico e propõe ajustes estratégicos.

Produto, Canal e Visão de Negócio

Documenta insights e recomendações de forma estruturada.

Atua como referência em design sprints e ciclos contínuos de feedback.

Orienta decisões de design com visão clara de negócio.

Analisa dados de uso (analytics) e acompanha métricas de design.

Identifica oportunidades de melhoria com impacto mensurável.

Traduz dados qualitativos e quantitativos em direcionamentos estratégicos.

Apresenta resultados para stakeholders de forma clara e orientada a objetivos.

Contribui com a priorização de backlog, apoiando a evolução contínua do produto.

Colaboração com Tecnologia

Aplica conhecimento em tecnologias web e mobile para decisões de design viáveis.

Define práticas eficientes de handoff para desenvolvimento.

Colabora em decisões sobre integrações técnicas e APIs.

Gerencia versionamento de design e documentação de changelog.

Apoia processos de QA, definindo critérios visuais e técnicos de validação.

Habilidades:

Habilidades Técnicas:

- UX Design

- UI Design

Habilidades Comportamentais:

- remoto

- COMUNICACAO DIGITAL & TRABALHO REMOTO

Idiomas:

- Inglês

Modelo de Trabalho: Híbrido -> 1 Dias de trabalho presencial

SP - Barueri

E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

Assistência médica;

VR e VA flexível;

Gympass e Wellz;

Parceria com o SESC;

Descontos em restaurantes;

Descontos em cursos técnicos e de ensinos superior;

Descontos em escolas e plataformas de idiomas.

E aí, aceita o desafio? Então conclua sua candidatura e #VemSerFoursys! Boa sorte!

title: Estágio Técnico de Elétrica
description:
Pronto para criar o seu impacto positivo? Então junte-se à Tractebel, parte do Grupo ENGIE, e aos nossos 5600 especialistas apaixonados em todo o mundo, motivados por moldar um mundo mais sustentável todos os dias. É a sua oportunidade de fazer parte da aventura do século: acelerar a transição energética - ao mesmo tempo que melhora a vida das pessoas, através de projetos com significado. Dê a sua contribuição para neutralizar o carbono em mercados como de nuclear, energia, infraestrutura, saneamento e meio ambiente.

Está pronto para fazer a diferença? Então, estamos animados para conhecer você!

O que oferecemos

  • A Tractebel é mais do que um local de trabalho. É a sua oportunidade de evoluir ao lado de especialistas em projetos com impacto global . É um ambiente baseado no espírito de equipe, onde você pode atingir o seu potencial máximo. Como Estagiário(a) Técnico(a) da área de Energia, você contribuirá para a nossa missão de construirmos juntos um futuro neutro em carbono todos os dias.

  • Elaborar diagramas unifilares e trifilares de SPCS.
  • Elaborar diagramas unifilares de serviços auxiliares CA e CC.
  • Desenvolver diagramas funcionais e lógicos de painéis de proteção e quadros de controle.
  • Elaborar desenhos construtivos de painéis e caixas de junção, incluindo vistas, lista de materiais e plaquetas.
  • Criar listas de cabos e listas de materiais para projetos de SPCS.
  • Elaborar diagramas de interligação.
  • Elaborar diagramas de fiação, lista de potenciais e topográficos.
  • Planejar a disposição de painéis em casas de comando.
  • Executar revisões de documentos conforme fabricado e conforme construído.

Gostaríamos de ser contactados por pessoas com

  • Cursando Técnico Elétrica/Eletrotécnica/Eletroeletrônica/Automação;
  • Domínio do pacote Office;
  • Noções de Autocad.

Quem somos

As nossas prioridades são as pessoas, a ética, a segurança e a sustentabilidade. Com a Tractebel, você pode ter um impacto positivo nos objetivos globais de neutralizar as emissões de carbono. O nosso maior ativo são os nossos empregados e a diversidade é a nossa força!

Saiba mais sobre a , as nossas atividades e o porquê de se deve juntar a nós!

Como parte do Grupo ENGIE , com 96.000 colaboradores, você terá oportunidades de trilhar seu caminho profissional sempre moldando um mundo mais sustentável.

Todas as nossas vagas estão disponíveis, também, para candidatos com deficiência ou beneficiários reabilitados pelo INSS.

The SAP AMS Project Manager is responsible for managing the delivery of SAP Application Management Services across multiple modules and business areas. The SAP AMS Project Manager also drives continuous improvement, governance, and customer satisfaction in a global delivery model.

Service & Project Delivery

Manage day-to-day SAP AMS operations, including incident, problem, change, and service request management.

Oversee delivery of SAP enhancements, small projects, and rollouts within agreed timelines and budgets.

Drive root cause analysis and preventive measures to reduce recurring incidents.

Stakeholder & Client Management

Act as the primary contact for clients regarding SAP AMS delivery.

Facilitate regular status, governance, and steering committee meetings.

Build and maintain strong business stakeholder relationships across Finance, Supply Chain, and other SAP domains.

Translate business priorities into SAP AMS delivery plans.

Allocate resources and track performance of functional and technical consultants.

Track AMS budgets, contract compliance, and cost optimization initiatives.

Identify and escalate risks/issues with mitigation strategies.

Support migration, upgrades, or transition projects (e.g., ECC to S/4HANA).

Deep understanding of SAP AMS operating model.

Strong leadership and team coordination skills.

title: Estágio em Planejamento
description:
Pronto para criar o seu impacto positivo? Então junte-se à Tractebel, parte do Grupo ENGIE, e aos nossos 5600 especialistas apaixonados em todo o mundo, motivados por moldar um mundo mais sustentável todos os dias. É a sua oportunidade de fazer parte da aventura do século: acelerar a transição energética - ao mesmo tempo que melhora a vida das pessoas, através de projetos com significado. Está pronto para fazer a diferença? Então, estamos animados para conhecer você!

O que oferecemos

  • A Tractebel é mais do que um local de trabalho. É a sua oportunidade de evoluir ao lado de especialistas em projetos com impacto global . É um ambiente baseado no espírito de equipe, onde você pode atingir o seu potencial máximo.   • Sabemos que o equilíbrio saudável entre vida pessoal e profissional é fundamental para seu bem-estar. Por isso, nosso regime de trabalho é hibrido e flexível ! Você pode trabalhar de casa até 1 dia por semana e pode iniciar suas atividades entre 7h30 e 9h30 e encerrar entre 16h30 e 18h30, respectivamente.
  • Entre o primeiro dia útil do ano e a última sexta-feira antes do carnaval, a empresa adota a jornada especial de verão . Você poderá usufruir de uma jornada reduzida às sextas-feiras, mediante compensação.
  • Para celebrarmos momentos especiais e simplesmente nos divertirmos, realizamos ações em datas comemorativas, presenteamos você no seu aniversário, festejamos juntos em nossa confraternização de fim de ano e muito mais.

A sua missão

Como Estagiário(a) de Planejamento do nosso departamento de Infraestrutura, você contribuirá para a nossa missão de construirmos juntos um futuro neutro em carbono todos os dias, desempenhando um papel crucial no desenvolvimento de estudos, programas e projetos socioeconômicos.

As suas principais responsabilidades

  • Apoiar no planejamento e controle físico-financeiro de projetos;
  • Auxiliar na elaboração e atualização de cronogramas, listas de documentos e pendências; Dar suporte ao Arquivo Técnico na gestão de documentos via Sistema GED;
  • Apoiar o controle financeiro de projetos;
  • Contribuir para a identificação de atrasos, elaboração de planos de ação e acompanhamento de cronogramas físicos;
  • Participar de reuniões de kick-off e follow-up dos projetos.

Gostaríamos de ser contactados por pessoas com

  • Formação superior em andamento em Engenharias;
  • Conhecimento básico em Excel e Pacote Office;
  • Interesse na área de Planejamento;
  • Conhecimento (desejável) em MS Project.

Quem somos

As nossas prioridades são as pessoas, a ética, a segurança e a sustentabilidade. Com a Tractebel, você pode ter um impacto positivo nos objetivos globais de neutralizar as emissões de carbono. O nosso maior ativo são os nossos empregados e a diversidade é a nossa força!

Saiba mais sobre a , as nossas atividades e o porquê de se deve juntar a nós!

Como parte do Grupo ENGIE , com 96.000 colaboradores, você terá oportunidades de trilhar seu caminho profissional sempre moldando um mundo mais sustentável.

description:
Descrição da vaga

Quer mover a sua carreira na Motiva?

A Motiva é o lugar certo para o seu talento, na qual você pode escolher o caminho que deseja seguir juntamente com uma empresa que promove a melhoria da qualidade de vida das pessoas por meio da mobilidade. Nos comprometemos em construir uma cultura cada vez mais diversa e valorizamos a inclusão de todas as pessoas independente de cor, etnia, religião, idade, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual ou deficiência, promovendo um ambiente inclusivo e com equidade de oportunidades.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Atuar como especialista em Red Hat OpenShift, garantindo a sustentação, evolução e modernização da plataforma de containers em ambientes híbridos (on-premises e cloud);

Propor, definir e implementar padrões de arquitetura, automação, governança e segurança aplicados ao OpenShift;

Trabalhar em conjunto com times de arquitetura, desenvolvimento, infraestrutura e segurança para assegurar resiliência, desempenho e aderência a padrões corporativos;

Automatizar rotinas de provisionamento, atualização, monitoramento, backup e recuperação de desastres (DR) dos clusters;

Apoiar a implantação e otimização de processos de observabilidade e gestão do ciclo de vida das aplicações containerizadas;

Produzir e manter documentações técnicas, boas práticas, padrões de uso e playbooks operacionais;

Utilizar experiência prévia em containers (Docker, CRI-O), Kubernetes, operadores e automação (Ansible, Terraform, Helm) para dar suporte as áreas;

Atuar em ambientes multicloud e híbridos (On Premisse, AWS, Azure), com foco em alta disponibilidade e escalabilidade;

Colaborar em iniciativas de FinOps e Observabilidade aplicadas ao OpenShift, contribuindo para eficiência operacional e otimização de custos.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que esperamos de você:

✅ Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia, Ciências da Computação, Tecnologia da Informação, Segurança de TI;

✅ Experiência em administração e arquitetura da plataforma Red Hat OpenShift;

✅ Conhecimento sólido em containers (Docker, CRI-O), Kubernetes e operadores;

✅ Vivência com automação e infraestrutura como código (Ansible, Terraform, Helm);

✅ Conhecimentos em redes, segurança de workloads, RBAC e políticas de acesso no OpenShift;

✅ Experiência em ambientes OpenShift multicloud/híbridos (On Premisse, AWS, Azure);

✅ Atuação em ambientes OpenShift com foco em resiliência e alta disponibilidade.

Você se destaca, se tiver:

✅ Certificações Red Hat OpenShift;

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

title: Senior Data Scientist / ML Engineer
description:
Project Description:

The primary goal of the project is the modernization, maintenance and development of an eCommerce platform for a big US-based retail company, serving millions of omnichannel customers each week.

Solutions are delivered by several Product Teams focused on different domains - Customer, Loyalty, Search and Browse, Data Integration, Cart.

Current overriding priorities are new brands onboarding, re-architecture, database migrations, migration of microservices to a unified cloud-native solution without any disruption to business.


Responsibilities:

  • We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer with Machine Learning expertise and good understanding of search engines, to work on the following:
  • - Design, develop, and optimize semantic and vector-based search solutions leveraging Lucene/Solr and modern embeddings.
  • - Apply machine learning, deep learning, and natural language processing techniques to improve search relevance and ranking.
  • - Develop scalable data pipelines and APIs for indexing, retrieval, and model inference.
  • - Integrate ML models and search capabilities into production systems.
  • - Evaluate, fine-tune, and monitor search performance metrics.
  • - Collaborate with software engineers, data engineers, and product teams to translate business needs into technical implementations.
  • - Stay current with advancements in search technologies, LLMs, and semantic retrieval frameworks.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 5+ years of experience in Data Science or Machine Learning Engineering, with a focus on Information Retrieval or Semantic Search.
  • Strong programming experience in both Java and Python (production-level code, not just prototyping).
  • Deep knowledge of Lucene, Apache Solr, or Elasticsearch (indexing, query tuning, analyzers, scoring models).
  • Experience with Vector Databases, Embeddings, and Semantic Search techniques.
  • Strong understanding of NLP techniques (tokenization, embeddings, transformers, etc.).
  • Experience deploying and maintaining ML/search systems in production.
  • Solid understanding of software engineering best practices (CI/CD, testing, version control, code review).


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Oracle Cloud Field Service consultant
description:
Job Specification: Oracle Cloud Field Service Consultant

Contract Role – Remote

Overview

We are seeking an experienced Oracle Cloud Field Service (OFS) Consultant to support the design, configuration, optimization, and ongoing enhancement of our field service operations. This is a remote contract role suited for someone with strong hands-on expertise in Oracle Field Service Cloud, with additional experience in Oracle Service Cloud (OSvC) and Oracle CPQ being highly desirable.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the implementation, configuration, and customization of Oracle Field Service Cloud (OFS) to support business workflows, scheduling, routing, and mobile field operations.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into scalable functional and technical solutions.
  • Configure OFS modules including capacity, activity management, work order orchestration, routing plans, and mobility experiences.
  • Integrate OFS with other Oracle cloud applications, especially Oracle Service Cloud , Oracle CPQ , and external systems via REST/SOAP APIs.
  • Perform solution testing, UAT support, documentation, and knowledge transfer to internal teams.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve system issues, ensuring seamless field operations.
  • Recommend best practices and continuous improvements in field service processes.
  • Support deployment activities, including data migration, configuration promotion, and post-go-live stabilization.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams including service operations, IT, product management, and vendors.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 3–5+ years of hands-on experience implementing and supporting Oracle Field Service Cloud (OFS) .
  • Strong understanding of OFS architecture, configuration frameworks, APIs, message scenarios, routing, and capacity planning.
  • Experience designing workflows, activity types, and policy configurations in OFS.
  • Ability to write and interpret OFS API integrations, business rules, and extensibility scripts.
  • Proven ability to gather requirements and convert them into actionable configuration.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues.
  • Experience working in Agile or hybrid project delivery environments.
  • Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills.

Desired Skills (Nice to Have)

  • Experience with Oracle Service Cloud (RightNow/OSvC) configuration, workflows, and integrations.
  • Experience with Oracle CPQ (quoting workflows, commerce rules, integrations).
  • Understanding of broader Oracle CX Cloud architecture and integrations.
  • Experience with mobile workforce or field service applications outside Oracle.
  • Knowledge of cloud integration tools (OIC, Boomi, MuleSoft, etc.).
